newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks rise amid strong economic outlook.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks rise amid strong economic outlook.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed ahead for the sixth straight session as investors saw strong prospects for the Venezuelan economy and company earnings, traders said on Tuesday.
"I think the bolsa is definitely set on an upward trend," Inverworld broker Francisco Diaz said.
The exchange's 19-share index gained 0.53 points to end at 6,863.52 points, as 53 million shares worth 4.7 billion bolivars ($9.8 million) changed hands, according to final figures from the bolsa.

Investment house Santander said in a research report that corporate earnings should start to improve beginning in the second quarter as companies begin to reap the benefits of an economy forecast to grow by four percent this year.
"We believe that corporate results will improve in the second quarter, more than offsetting lackluster operating results posted in the first," it said.
Merinvest's composite index, which includes telephone company CANTV, rose 0.4 percent to 108.89 points. Among issues that were traded, 31 rose, eight fell and six closed unchanged.
